faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Multi Purpose Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BMC Multi Purpose Worker recruitment is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Multi Purpose Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard and have knowledge of Marathi to be eligible for the Multi Purpose Worker post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Multi Purpose Worker position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Multi Purpose Worker post released by Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika (BMC).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 38 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Multi Purpose Worker role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a lottery system followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity with Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika (BMC).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location is Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. What is the starting date for applications?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 27 August 2026.
